top_5_failure_modes.description: Customer message mentions both an iOS update and battery drain simultaneously. The single-label classifier picks one intent, omitting troubleshooting for the second symptom.
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: Someone from another state is trying to log into my iCloud account and I got a prompt on my screen.
top_5_failure_modes.expected_behavior: Acknowledge both iOS 11 indexing and provide dual battery + update diagnostic advice.
top_5_failure_modes.likely_cause: Single-label classification architecture on multi-symptom customer tweets.
top_5_failure_modes.possible_improvement: Implement multi-label classification or hierarchical intent routing for compound queries.

top_5_failure_modes.category: False Escalation on High Emotion / Slang
top_5_failure_modes.description: Customer uses strong words expressing frustration (e.g., 'this update is garbage, help!') triggering ambiguity thresholds even when the underlying technical issue is routine.
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: Apple your latest update is complete trash, fix my keyboard lag now!
top_5_failure_modes.expected_behavior: AUTO_HANDLE with keyboard dictionary reset steps.
top_5_failure_modes.actual_behavior: ESCALATED_TO_HUMAN due to aggressive sentiment / low keyword match score.
top_5_failure_modes.likely_cause: Escalation rules penalizing emotional tweets without separating sentiment from technical intent.
top_5_failure_modes.possible_improvement: Decouple sentiment analysis from technical triage; escalate only on genuine security/safety/legal risks.

top_5_failure_modes.category: Hardware Model Specificity Mismatch in Retrieval
top_5_failure_modes.description: Customer mentions a newer device model (e.g. iPhone X gestures), but vector retrieval surfaces historical resolution from older devices (e.g. iPhone 6 Home button).
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: How do I force restart iPhone X when the screen is frozen?
top_5_failure_modes.expected_behavior: Retrieve Volume Up > Volume Down > Side button sequence for iPhone X.
top_5_failure_modes.actual_behavior: Retrieved Home + Power button combination for iPhone 6s.
top_5_failure_modes.likely_cause: Embedding semantic search matching 'force restart frozen screen' strongly without hard filtering on hardware model generation.
top_5_failure_modes.possible_improvement: Add entity extraction for device model (e.g. iPhone X vs iPhone 7) and apply hard metadata filters during vector retrieval.

top_5_failure_modes.description: Customer tweets 2-3 words like 'Phone broke' or 'Need help asap'. System cannot ascertain intent reliably.
top_5_failure_modes.expected_behavior: ESCALATE to human or trigger structured interactive clarification prompt.
top_5_failure_modes.actual_behavior: ESCALATED with reason: 'Ambiguous query lacking diagnostic context'.
top_5_failure_modes.likely_cause: Lack of customer information in Twitter one-liners.
top_5_failure_modes.possible_improvement: Deploy an automated clarifying probing question asking for device model and exact symptom.

top_5_failure_modes.description: Customer refers to emerging feature names or non-standard slang ('AirDrop not finding my friend') overlapping with Bluetooth connectivity.
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: AirDrop won't discover my friend's iPhone nearby.
top_5_failure_modes.expected_behavior: Classify as connectivity_network_bluetooth with AirDrop receiving setting checks.
top_5_failure_modes.actual_behavior: Low intent confidence causing fallback escalation.
top_5_failure_modes.likely_cause: AirDrop combines Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and Contacts permissions, confusing single-intent boundaries.
top_5_failure_modes.possible_improvement: Expand intent taxonomy synonym dictionary to explicitly map AirDrop / Personal Hotspot / AirPlay to network intents.
